label: If y is PRIOR_4 to x, then x depends for its being on y and y does not so depend on x
paraphrase: OPEN bridge, PRIOR_4 sibling of 47aff057: for all y and x, if y is prior to x in being (y can be without x and x cannot be without y), then x depends for its being on y and y does not depend for its being on x (DependsForBeing, DEF-DEPENDS-FOR-BEING). With PRIOR_4 defined by being-without, this is a bridge from being-without to dependence for being, supported by In V Metaph. lect. 13 n. 18 ('priora non dependent a posterioribus, sicut e converso'; claim 95f41960 reads that text as dependence running one way), not a definitional truth. It follows from the being-without bridges 000e1f65 and 8ab3d114 with excluded middle (this batch). It inherits the failure case recorded for 8ab3d114: if the second relatum is necessary, the first may be independent of it although no world has the first without it. On the real-possibility reading of CanBeWithout, every necessary y is PRIOR_4 to every contingent x that y can be without (x cannot be without a necessary y), so this statement makes each such x depend for its being on y; the derivation applies 8ab3d114 to exactly that case (¬ D x y → W x y with y necessary).
